run_dreambooth_lora_flux2_img2img: run the DreamBooth LoRA training script for FLUX.2 Klein image-to-image fine-tuning with custom dataset
parse_dreambooth_args: parse command-line arguments for DreamBooth LoRA training with support for dataset, LoRA config, optimizer, and validation options
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that loads instance images with optional condition images, aspect-ratio buckets, and paired transforms
log_validation_dreambooth: log validation images generated from the trained LoRA pipeline to tensorboard or wandb during training
